messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P1 page triggered for POLARIS (enterprise/polaris-prod) — streaming websocket disconnects reported by customer

oncall-bot: Impact: sustained 5xxs on /v1/stream (ws) for tenant polaris-prod across a subset of Dedicated pool nodes. Pager: samir.khan. Handoff instructions in thread.

samir.khan: I'm on it. seeing reconnect spikes starting ~10:06 UTC, roughly 20% of connections dropping with 100ms time-to-first-byte then CLOSE.

samir.khan: Polaris SRE reported errors in their edge logs: "websocket: read/write timeout" and repeated client retry loops.

polaris-sre: confirming — our mobile clients see stream disconnects and immediate retry. Conversation started when some users saw degraded realtime events. Not all sessions, seems localized to a small set of public IPs.

linda.hsu: tagging infra — can we confirm gw side timeouts? i'll check proxy + gateway metrics.

ryan: looking at gateway dashboards now — there are THROTTLE spikes on dedicated-pool-a (zone us-west-2a) between 10:05-10:20 UTC. p99 latency also up from 45ms -> 220ms.

infra-bot: node metrics snapshot attached: (cpu 48%, net 74% util), conn_count per-node: [1200, 1188, 600, 1300]. The smaller set corresponds to pods showing frequent websocket CLOSEs.

samir.khan: suspecting connection exhaustion + upstream idle timeouts. can we tail gateway logs for polaris-prod?

ryan: tail logs:
```
2026-06-18T10:07:12Z gw-proxy-3 polaris-prod [conn 0x7f9a] ERROR websocket read timed out after 30s
2026-06-18T10:07:13Z gw-proxy-3 polaris-prod [conn 0x7f9b] WARN client retried too fast
2026-06-18T10:07:14Z gw-proxy-1 polaris-prod [conn 0x6a1c] INFO stream resumed
```

linda.hsu: gateway idle_timeouts are 30s on the proxy layer, upstream LB has 60s. Client heartbeats are every 45s for Polaris app — mismatch could cause mid-flight disconnects during spike.

polaris-sre: our clients do heartbeat every 45s yes. We only started seeing failures when concurrent sessions jumped ~2.5x due to a campaign.

samir.khan: immediate mitigation options: 1) increase proxy idle timeout to 90s for polaris-prod route 2) pin polaris to a smaller subset of nodes with headroom 3) enable jittered retry window on client side (we can suggest)

eng-oncall: i'll coordinate quick config change. Samir, can you prepare the patch to nginx/proxy config and we’ll rollout only to the polaris route?

samir.khan: preparing patch now. patch:
```
http {
  map $tenant $idle_timeout {
    default 30s;
    polaris-prod 90s;
  }
}
```

samir.khan: applying to dedicated-pool-a-pol config via canary (kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -n prod --patch '...')

infra-bot: deploy started. canary to 1/4 nodes in dedicated-pool-a. Expected completion 3 mins.

ryan: after canary rollout, CONNECT success rate for polaris improved from 78% -> 95% on patched nodes. p99 latency back to ~60ms on those nodes.

polaris-sre: confirming improved behaviour from our side on the sessions routed to the patched nodes. still a small tail of failures on other nodes. How long to finish rollout?

eng-oncall: continue rollout to remaining nodes, but keep monitor for excessive connection counts. If we hit net saturation we should pause.

infra-bot: canary complete. full rollout initiated — expected 4 mins.

samir.khan: rolling back temporary aggressive keepalive settings we tried earlier, leaving idle_timeout=90s only for polaris-prod. Also enabling per-tenant connection_limit=1600 to protect other tenants.

ryan: after full rollout, overall errors for polaris dropped 86% in the 10 minutes post-rollout. client-side backoffs reduced.

polaris-sre: thanks. any postmortem asks from our side? we need to know root cause — was it our campaign traffic, gateway misconfig, or both?

samir.khan: preliminary RCA: traffic surge from campaign increased concurrent ws sessions beyond expected capacity which uncovered a proxy idle timeout mismatch and uneven load distribution across nodes. Contributing factors: (1) tenant pinned to older node subset with lower conn_limit due to historical affinity, (2) proxy idle timeout shorter than client heartbeat, (3) retry bursts from client creating reconnect storms.

samir.khan: next action items (short):
- infra: implement per-tenant connection isolation and conn_limit defaults (owner: ryan)
- platform: add guardrail that warns when client heartbeat > proxy idle timeout on modelled routes (owner: linda)
- polaris: adjust client heartbeat to <= 30s or implement jittered backoff (owner: polaris-sre)
- eng: run load test simulating campaign traffic to validate autoscale thresholds (owner: samir)

linda.hsu: added tasks to infra board. i'll follow up with a config audit for other enterprise tenants.

eng-oncall: handing off monitoring to night shift. samir, please escalate if metrics regress.

samir.khan: acknowledged. i'll keep paging if errors spike >10% above baseline.

polaris-sre: we'll also add client-side jitter and push a small patch this evening. thanks for quick turnaround. :heart:

oncall-bot: Incident downgraded to P2 — customer impact reduced. Keep postmortem in #postmortems when ready.

samir.khan: saving logs/artifacts to incident ticket INC-2026-1123. Will follow up with full postmortem and timeline in 24h.

ryan: attaching perf graphs and connection heatmap to ticket.

infra-bot: automated snapshot uploaded: gateway-config diff + node metrics.

eng-oncall: night shift acknowledged. closing on-call loop here.

polaris-sre: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick mitigation. we’ll coordinate the longer-term fixes.
